label: Bible Study
prompt: Not of works, lest any man should _____.
verse: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
note: The sequel to 'by grace are ye saved' — so nobody gets bragging rights.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy _____ shall be ended.
verse: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
note: A sun that never sets, because God Himself is the light — and the days of mourning are ended.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her _____.
verse: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
note: Over went Jonah, and the sea ceased from her raging — instantly.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the _____ would immediately cry out.
verse: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
note: Pharisees wanted the cheering crowd hushed on the road to Jerusalem; Jesus said creation itself would take up the song.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Only be thou strong and very _____, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
verse: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
note: 'Be strong and of a good courage' appears in 1:6 and 1:9 — but 1:7 turns it up: 'very courageous.'
